## Description

**What**: Update existing docs (CLAUDE.md, planning-skill SKILL.md cross-links, KNOWN-ISSUES.md if recurring patterns surface) to reflect strata-sdk-facts/ + strata-sdk-guidance/ contracts, the strata:scoped tag lifecycle, the regeneration tool, the drift-detection CI cron, and the fail-open semantics. Follow .claude/docs/DOCUMENTATION-GUIDE.md.
**Why**: Future agents need accurate awareness of the conditional load points and tag semantics.
**Scope**:
- IN: Concise updates to listed docs; cross-link from CLAUDE.md to strata-sdk-facts/README.md; document strata:scoped tag lifecycle.
- OUT: New documentation files; restructuring CLAUDE.md beyond targeted updates.

## Done Definitions
- When complete, CLAUDE.md references strata-sdk-facts/ + strata-sdk-guidance/ + strata:scoped tag + regeneration tool + drift cron
- When complete, .claude/docs/DOCUMENTATION-GUIDE.md formatting followed
- When complete, planning-skill SKILL.md cross-links updated

## Considerations
- [Maintainability] Concise; link don't copy

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: Update project docs to reflect Strata SDK planning context
